d:
The MG Hector Tomahawk PHEV promises the silence and low running costs of EVs with the range flexibility of petrol. It's also being pitched as an alternative to diesel SUVs. Does it deliver? Nikhil Bhatia learns more over a 900km plus drive from Gurugram to Ahmedabad.
Cameraperson: Roshni Manghani (plus official B Roll)
Editor: Mohit Sharma
